hook: Twelve years passed before Chris Rock directed another film.

sections.voiceover: Twelve years passed before Chris Rock directed another film.

In October, A24 scheduled the theatrical release of Misty Green after festival premieres. Slow Horses star Rosalind Eleazar portrays a struggling actress facing a stalled career. Where did her stalled career lead?
Hollywood satire became the director's sharpest weapon yet.
Chris Rock wrote and directed this blistering new feature. Rosalind Eleazar anchors the A24 project in the title role. A24 brings the satirical drama to theaters.
Twelve years defines this directorial return.
